name: A Difficult Path
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine its of some importance to a paladin like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
narrative.objectives: Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.
narrative.offerRewardText: Your training can now begin in earnest, champion. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
